'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Erwin DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Erwin]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
